schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE `atom` (
  `atom_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `molecule_id` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `element` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`atom_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`molecule_id`) REFERENCES `molecule` (`molecule_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `bond` (
  `bond_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `molecule_id` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  `bond_type` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`bond_id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`molecule_id`) REFERENCES `molecule` (`molecule_id`)
);

CREATE TABLE `connected` (
  `atom_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `atom_id2` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `bond_id` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`atom_id`,`atom_id2`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`atom_id`) REFERENCES `atom` (`atom_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`atom_id2`) REFERENCES `atom` (`atom_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (`bond_id`) REFERENCES `bond` (`bond_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE `molecule` (
  `molecule_id` TEXT NOT NULL,
  `label` TEXT DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`molecule_id`)
);
q1: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN T1.bond_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.bond_id) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'
q2: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T2.bond_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '-'
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN T1.bond_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.bond_id) FROM bond AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T1.bond_type = '-'
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(T2.bond_id) FROM molecule AS T1 INNER JOIN bond AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id WHERE T2.bond_type = '-'
counterexample: INSERT INTO molecule (molecule_id, label) VALUES ('M1', '+'); INSERT INTO bond (bond_id, molecule_id, bond_type) VALUES ('B1', 'M1', '-'); INSERT INTO bond (bond_id, molecule_id, bond_type) VALUES ('B2', NULL, '-');
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent because they are calculating different things. Q1 calculates the percentage of bonds in a molecule that are positively labeled, while Q2 calculates the proportion of bonds that are positively labeled in the entire bond table.
counterexample_dsp: The difference is triggered when there are bonds in the bond table that are not associated with any molecule in the molecule table.
